{{Top|leg}}
A '''codebreaker card''' was a security measure used to encrypt [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]]. The codebreaker card had to be used to decode a read the encrypted datacard. [[Neil Barani]] used a codebreaker card to encrypt the datacard holding the [[Barani List]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
